title: Right after character creation, the very first 'status' call showed two seemingly-parallel, never-explained verse trackers at once: 'Old Court Verses: 0/3 (ring-ditch, king's causeway, mere-stone)' and 'Verses: 0/3 (drowned shrine, old watchtower, barrow hall)'. Only the second one persisted in later checks, with 'drowned shrine' silently renamed to 'sunken shrine' — reads like leftover/duplicate quest-tracking text.
where: status screen, turn 5 (Village Gate/Last Light Square)
